definition: a harbour for small pleasure boats
description: In a marina at sunrise, with rows of white motor yachts and sailing boats with tall masts moored along wooden jetties, a muscular man in sunglasses and a white bathrobe kneels on a big pink inflatable flamingo, paddling with a wooden oar and balancing a tray of coffee cups and pastries. A small dog watches from the jetty, a couple in bathrobes stand on the jetty and an older man leans from the bow of a boat. Ripples spread on the calm golden water.
